Welcome to the **Isogeny-based Cryptography Wiki**. This site serves as an open-source, mathematically rigorous, and accessible repository of knowledge detailing post-quantum cryptographic schemes built on the hardness of finding isogenies between elliptic curves.

## Getting Started

If you are not familiar with cryptographic schemes, we recommend [this book draft](https://toc.cryptobook.us/) by Dan Boneh and Victor Shoup. For the underlying mathematics, see [Steven Galbraith's book](https://www.math.auckland.ac.nz/~sgal018/crypto-book/crypto-book.html). You may also benefit from reading PhD theses in this area, for instance [this list](https://github.com/GiacomoPope/maths-theses) curated by Giacomo Pope.

You may also find good reference material in past schools, such as [Bristol 2020](https://isogenyschool2020.co.uk/schedule/), [ANTS 2020](https://www.youtube.com/@ANTSSummerSchool/videos), [PCMI 2022](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLldN_DpkXL3amFV76Dmimhbrm0MYa4d32), [IPAM 2022](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHyI3Fbmv0SdibCMJcJFBZPARwec6fPnQ), [VaNTAGe 2022](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLo3uxbU5v05z8XnaEeNYI_xbn_IrvgLvJ),  [CIMPA 2024](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLxG_np9o-2fSsZcOq0woYWBxbiSFy1qI), [SLMath 2024](https://www.slmath.org/summer-schools/1068#schedule_notes), [PQCSA 2025](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLiHaXFHjrqYcvzIxFEo118XCzxI-KSctT), and [AWS 2026](https://swc-math.github.io/aws/2026/index.html).

To engage with the community, consider joining activities such as the [Isogeny Club](https://isogeny.club/), [Leuven Isogeny Days](https://www.esat.kuleuven.be/cosic/projects/isocrypt/workshops/), [BIRS workshops](https://www.birs.ca/events/2025/5-day-workshops/25w5500), and [Swissogeny Day](https://swissogeny.github.io/).

## Cryptographic Schemes

This wiki aims to cover all peer-reviewed isogeny-based key exchange schemes (including KEM, etc.) and digital signature schemes.

**Legend:** []{r=100} torsion points; []{b=100} quaternion algebra; []{g=100} group action;

## Contributing

This wiki is maintained by the **isogeny-crypto** organization. If you spot a mathematical error, want to expand on a protocol's performance metrics, or wish to add a new primitive:

1. Fork the repository on [GitHub](https://github.com/isogeny-crypto/isogeny-crypto.github.io).
2. Create your article using a `.qmd` file in the `schemes/` directory.
3. Submit a Pull Request.
